name: Overbroad503.nginx-html-503
why: nginx-style HTML 503 page is a generic reverse-proxy/maintenance response, not a model service; HTML at any status maps to html-non-model.

/v1/models.body_text:
503 Service Temporarily Unavailable

nginx

name: Overbroad503.error-string
why: JSON body whose error member is a bare string (maintenance), not the llama.cpp error-object envelope; must stay non-2xx-non-model-http.

name: Overbroad503.no-slot-available
why: Real llama.cpp unavailable_error envelope but message is 'no slot available' (server up, all slots busy) — message mismatch means FOREIGN_SERVICE, not MODEL_LOADING.

name: Overbroad503.lowercase-loading
why: Envelope shape is right but message 'loading model' is lowercase; the C1 rule requires exact 'Loading model', so a case-insensitive implementation is overbroad.

name: Overbroad503.server-error-type
why: Message matches 'Loading model' but type is server_error, not unavailable_error — a different failure mode that must not read as a model still loading.

name: Overbroad503.code-string
why: Envelope carries code "503" as a JSON string, not the integer 503; the rule requires an integer code so a string-coercing check is overbroad.

name: Overbroad503.no-error-wrapper
why: Loading fields sit at the JSON top level without the error object wrapper; envelope detection must require the nested error member.

name: Overbroad503.plaintext-loading
why: text/plain 503 body 'Loading model' (e.g. a hand-rolled proxy) contains the right words but is not the JSON envelope; body sniffing the phrase is overbroad.
